name: postbox-services
description: Live email deliverability and security checks: blacklists, spoofing grade, redirect tracing, mail tests, WHOIS, BIMI and AI discoverability.

interface.longDescription:
Run live email deliverability and security checks from ChatGPT and get answers from real lookups, each with a link to a full report.

Check a domain or IP against email blacklists, grade a domain's spoofing and business email compromise exposure from SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and trace a link through every redirect to where it really goes.

Test a real email: get a disposable address, send a message to it from your own system, and get a score out of 10 with a breakdown and fixes. You can also analyze a raw .eml file.

Look up a domain's age and WHOIS details, check a BIMI record and logo, and grade how visible a website is to AI answer engines.

No sign-in is needed. Postbox Services is run by Postbox Consultancy Services, an email deliverability consultancy.
capabilities: Look up domain age and WHOIS
Check a BIMI record and logo
defaultPrompt: Is example.com on any email blacklists?
How exposed is example.com to email spoofing?
Where does this link really go: http://github.com

positive.prompt: Is example.com on any email blacklists?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether example.com is listed, with the number of domain blacklists checked and a link to the full report.

positive.prompt: How exposed is postboxservices.com to email spoofing? Grade it.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives an A-F grade for postboxservices.com with findings from its SPF and DMARC records and a link to the full check.

positive.prompt: Where does this link really go: http://github.com
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each redirect hop with its status and names the final destination.

positive.prompt: Does paypal.com have a valid BIMI setup?
positive.expected_behavior: Says a BIMI record exists, reports the logo checks, says a certificate is referenced but not verified, and says DMARC is a separate requirement.

positive.prompt: How discoverable is postboxservices.com to AI search engines?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives an A-F grade with AI crawler access and sitemap status, and a link to the full report.

negative.prompt: Send a marketing email to my customer list.
Remove my IP address from the Spamhaus blacklist for me.
Change the DMARC record on my domain to p=reject.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: email blacklist, spoofing, redirect, mail test, raw email, domain age, WHOIS, BIMI and AI discoverability checks.
